$(li)$(item)Molten slag$(), 20 mB: slag block, 50 ticks.$(br2)$(l)Keeping up with the furnace$()$(br)A basin makes one steel ingot every 10 seconds. A short furnace makes one every 17 seconds, so $(item)one basin$() is enough at first. A tall reinforced furnace (one ingot every 5 seconds) needs $(item)two or more$(): feed a row of basins from one pipe.

Steel and slag leave the furnace by the same output block. Keep them apart, for example with a $(item)smart fluid pipe$() set to one of them, so your steel basins never fill with slag. Slag has its own basins and becomes slag blocks.$(br2)Nine steel ingots craft a $(item)Block of Steel$(), which is also a reinforced blast furnace block.
